name: JoyAI-Video-Edit
license: code and weights Apache-2.0; text encoder MiMo-VL-7B-RL-2508 MIT
notes: Causal streaming V2V (instruction) and RV2V (one reference image). One prompt per causal KV session: every applied text/reference event restarts the session on the next live frame. Reference state is single-slot: set/patch/remove/reset are applied when the resulting state has exactly one slot, otherwise acked unsupported (2+ slots, or empty state). Source passed through before the first edit. Output 840x480 (480x840 portrait) at up to 24 fps; source frames dropped when the model falls behind (max 2 chunks in flight). Reference prompt: 'Replace the <slot scope target> in the video with the one from the reference image, ...' (upstream RV2V phrasing). Presence gates and prompt enhancement off.
